text: Hey, are we still on for dinner tonight? I can book a table for seven if that works for everyone.
Happy birthday! I hope you have a great day and that this year brings you everything you wished for.
Sorry I missed your call, I was in the middle of cooking. Is everything okay? I'm free now if you want to talk.
Mom, I landed safely. The flight was a bit bumpy but fine. I'll call you tomorrow once I've had some sleep.
Congratulations on the new job! You worked so hard for this and you really deserve it. Drinks are on me this weekend.
Could you pick up some milk and bread on your way home? We also need eggs if the shop still has any.
I'm so sorry about last night. I was tired and said things I didn't mean. Can we talk about it over coffee?
Who's in for a hike on Saturday? The weather looks perfect, and we could stop for lunch at that place by the lake.
Good morning! Did you sleep well? I made coffee, and there are fresh rolls on the table.
Thank you so much for the gift. It was exactly what I needed, and I use it every single day.
I can't make it on Friday, I'm sorry. My sister is visiting and I promised to show her around. How about next week?
Are you free this weekend? I was thinking we could go to the cinema and get something to eat afterwards.
Just a reminder that Grandma's birthday is on Sunday. I'll bring the cake, can you take care of the flowers?
I saw this and thought of you right away. Remember that summer by the sea? We should go back there one day.
The kids are finally asleep. Let's watch one episode and then go to bed early for once.
I heard about your dad. I'm so sorry. If you need anything at all, even just someone to sit with you, call me.
We're moving next month! The new flat is smaller but much brighter, and it has a little balcony.
Thanks for dinner last night, everything was delicious. You have to give me the recipe for that soup.
I think I left my umbrella at your place. Could you check by the door? It's the black one with a wooden handle.
How was the exam? I was thinking about you all morning. I'm sure it went better than you think.
Could you water my plants while I'm away? It's just for a week, and I'll leave the keys with the neighbor.
Sorry for the late reply, this week has been crazy. Yes, I'd love to come. Just tell me when and where.
I know we haven't talked in a while, and that's mostly my fault. I miss our long walks and silly jokes. Would you like to meet for coffee this month? I'd really like to hear how you've been.
The car is making that strange noise again. I booked the garage for Tuesday morning, so I'll need a lift to work.
